05 / The little details

A few things.
Then, just enjoy.

The practical bits, kept close so we can spend more time being there.

Flights & our first-class train
19 Sep · KL0602 leaves LAX Terminal B at 13:50 and arrives in Amsterdam at 09:05 on 20 Sep. KL1615 continues at 10:20, arriving at Milan Linate at 12:00.

21 Sep · Frecciarossa 9639, Milano Centrale 14:30 → Roma Termini 17:40. First class, coach 3, seats 6A & 6B. Keep the original tickets handy.
Dress codes & arriving for dinner
Osteria Serafina asks guests to avoid overly sporty clothing and flip-flops; the reservation is cancelled after a 15-minute delay.

Osteria Da Fortunata holds the table for 10 minutes. Our confirmed location is Via dei Baullari, 112.

Gigi requests casual chic, holds the table for 15 minutes, and allows two hours for dinner.
Our Rome by Vespa morning
Tuesday, 22 September at 11:00 · Rome by Vespa: Classic Rome Tour with Pick up & Drop Off, for two adults, with Dearoma Tours.

The confirmation schedules payment for 20 September, with tickets issued after payment. The pickup location and exact duration are still to be confirmed with the operator.
Hotel touches worth remembering
Hotel Viu Milan includes a $50 experience credit on qualifying hotel charges. Ask the front desk about eligible uses. Upgrades and early or late checkout depend on availability.

Argentum lists breakfast as an extra and asks for the expected arrival time in advance.

Maison Albar asks guests arriving after 21:00 to contact the hotel directly.
Still to add to our little book
The Rome–Paris transfer on 24 September and the journey home are not included in the supplied confirmations. We also need the Vespa pickup details.

23 September is deliberately shown as an open day; no activity reservation was supplied. Any ideas shown there are optional, unbooked inspiration.

CHAPTER 43Milano · Roma · Paris / September 2026

A little note for a big year

My dear Saman,

Some birthdays call for a cake. This one called for a few flights, a table for two, and a little more time together.

Here’s to all the conversations we’ll finish over dinner, the streets we’ll get happily lost in, and the moments that will become “remember when…” before we know it.

Forty-three looks beautiful on you. I’m so glad I get to be here for this chapter.

To us, and everything still to come. ♡
